content: Twitter/X summary_large_image: recommend 1200x675 (16:9) or 1200x630, matches OG dimensions so one image serves both. Minimum 300x157 - below that X silently downgrades to 'summary' card (no error) and below an absolute floor falls back to text-only. X reads twitter:image first, falls back to og:image automatically, so a site can skip twitter:image entirely if og:image is already correct-sized.
